title: Anthropic · 定价来源更新
summary: Major credit cards are accepted for standard accounts. To buy credits or manage your payment methods, go to the Billing page (platform.claude.com/settings/billing) in the Claude Console. Enterprise customers can arrange invoicing and other payment methods.
